t: Double Fun Game | Board Game | BoardGameGeek
s: Double Fun Game uses two decks of cards to play several games that gradually teach a child how to read. In the first game, players place a Store Card (Grocery Store, Pet Store, Toy Store and Hardware Store) in front of them. On your turn you draw a picture card from the deck, and if it matches an item on your Store Card you keep it.
